shelters.name: Humane Society of Utah
shelters.description: Animal shelter/clinic offering affordable spays/neuters and vaccinations, pet adoptions and rehoming, and training.

shelters.name: Best Friends Animal Society - Salt Lake City
shelters.description: Leading No-Kill Utah initiative. Foster-based pet adoption center taking in over 2,500 animals yearly including neonatal kittens, dogs and cats.

shelters.name: Salt Lake County Animal Services
shelters.description: Premier animal service agency in Utah serving Bluffdale, Holladay, Midvale, Millcreek, Murray, Salt Lake City and surrounding metro townships.

shelters.name: Humane Society of Northern Utah
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit established in 2008. Provides emergency medical, pet adoptions, and pet education. Partners with South Ogden Animal Shelter.

shelters.name: Weber County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Working to become a No-Kill Community, valuing each individual animal's life and providing compassion and care.

shelters.name: South Utah Valley Animal Shelter
shelters.description: Serves animals and residents of southern Utah County including Elk Ridge, Mapleton, Payson, Provo, Salem, Santaquin, Spanish Fork, Springville, and Woodland Hills.

shelters.name: Cache Humane Society
shelters.description: Local no-kill, nonprofit animal shelter offering affordable spays, neuters, and vaccinations.

shelters.name: Paws For Life Utah
shelters.description: Rescues over 1,500 shelter pets yearly. Finds loving homes for every adoptable pet that enters their program.

shelters.name: PAWS - Providing Animals With Support
shelters.description: 501(c)(3) nonprofit, no-kill animal rescue since 2002. Has rescued over 25,000 cats and dogs.

shelters.name: St. George Animal Shelter
shelters.description: City-owned animal shelter playing pivotal role in making Utah the first no-kill state in the West.

shelters.name: Nuzzles & Co
shelters.description: Animal rescue organization serving Park City and Summit County area.

shelters.name: Underdog Animal Rescue and Rehab
shelters.description: Animal rescue and rehabilitation organization serving the Salt Lake City area.

shelters.name: Utah Animal Adoption Center
shelters.description: Animal adoption center serving the Salt Lake City metropolitan area.

shelters.name: Cache County Animal Services
shelters.description: Provides and promotes the most caring and humane treatment for animals, striving to be at the forefront of resources for stray and abandoned animals.

shelters.name: Utah County Animal Shelter
shelters.description: County animal shelter serving Utah County and the Provo area.

notes: Comprehensive collection of Utah animal shelters, humane societies, and rescue organizations. Utah designated 2024 as No-Kill Shelter Year with 46 of 58 shelters achieving no-kill status. Best Friends Animal Society leads No-Kill Utah initiative. PAWS St. George has rescued over 25,000 animals since 2002. Coverage spans Salt Lake City, Ogden, Provo, Logan, St. George, Park City, and Heber City.
